modules.title: Digital Literacy Basics
modules.description: Learn how to use smartphones, internet, and basic apps to improve your life and work.

lessons.title: Introduction to Smartphones
lessons.content: A smartphone is a mobile phone with internet and apps. You can use it for calls, messages, photos, and work tasks.
key_points: Smartphones run on Android or iOS
Apps help you with different tasks
You can connect to the internet via data or Wi-Fi
lessons.local_example: Using WhatsApp to communicate with customers or family.

lessons.title: Using the Internet
lessons.content: The internet connects you to websites, emails, and social media.
key_points: Use Google to search for information
Watch YouTube to learn new skills
Avoid scams and unknown links
lessons.local_example: Searching for job opportunities on Facebook groups.

quiz.question: What is a smartphone?
options: A phone with apps and internet
quiz.answer: A phone with apps and internet

quiz.question: Why is the internet useful?
options: To find info, connect, and learn
quiz.answer: To find info, connect, and learn

modules.title: Basic Farming Skills
modules.description: Learn how to grow crops effectively, prepare land, and manage pests.

lessons.title: Soil Preparation
lessons.content: Good farming starts with proper soil preparation like tilling and adding compost.
key_points: Remove weeds before planting
Use organic manure to enrich soil
Make ridges or beds depending on crop
lessons.local_example: Using compost from maize husks and animal waste.

lessons.title: Planting and Spacing
lessons.content: Proper spacing and correct planting methods help crops grow well.
key_points: Follow spacing for each crop (e.g., 75cm for maize)
Plant at right depth (2–5cm)
Use clean, treated seeds
lessons.local_example: Spacing tomatoes correctly in a backyard garden.

quiz.question: Why is crop spacing important?
options: To help growth and reduce disease
quiz.answer: To help growth and reduce disease

modules.title: Introduction to Tailoring
modules.description: Learn the basics of measuring, cutting, and sewing clothes.

lessons.title: Taking Body Measurements
lessons.content: Use a tape measure to get accurate body measurements for fitting clothes.
key_points: Measure chest, waist, hips, and height
Use inches or centimeters
Always write down your measurements
lessons.local_example: Measuring customers before sewing school uniforms.

lessons.title: Sewing Simple Clothes
lessons.content: Learn to use hand-sewing or sewing machines to make basic garments.
key_points: Thread a needle or machine correctly
Start with pillowcases, shorts or aprons
Use patterns to cut fabric accurately
lessons.local_example: Sewing chitenges and shirts at home to sell.

quiz.question: What tool is used to measure the body?

modules.title: Basic Baking at Home
modules.description: Learn to bake mandasi, cakes, and bread using simple ingredients.

lessons.title: Ingredients and Tools
lessons.content: Gather flour, sugar, baking powder, eggs, and basic tools like bowls and spoons.
key_points: Clean hands and tools are important
Measure ingredients properly
Use an oven, charcoal stove or frying pan
lessons.local_example: Baking mandasi for sale in the market.

lessons.title: Making Mandasi (Fritters)
lessons.content: Mix flour, sugar, water and yeast or baking powder to make tasty mandasi.
key_points: Let dough rise before frying
Use hot oil but don’t burn
Sell them fresh for better taste
lessons.local_example: Selling baked snacks at school or church events.

quiz.question: What should you do before baking?
